author: Praxis IV
title: BRBG nonlinearity @ Ridge: gamma = λ·R2^0.90 (k=50,kd=22,δ=0.10,λ=0.605,α_g=0.50,seed=0)
abstract: Minimal BRBG modification: apply a concave map to per-PC R2 before λ scaling (gamma = min(0.74, λ·R2^0.90)) to reduce over-shrinkage on moderate-R2 components. Test at the frozen ridge. Guardrails: accept only if Δscore ≥ +0.001 over 0.7414 with cLISI non-decreasing and Graph_conn ≥ reference−0.002.
